reason: Free for me is fine, but the page leaves blank who checks the crews and what happens if one stops halfway with my money already paid. I already get three quotes myself, and I would rather pay the crew directly than trust a new name to pick them.
objection: Who checks these crews, and what do I get back if one walks off mid-job?
would_change_my_mind: A named verification process for the crews and a written promise on what happens if a crew stops mid-job, with my money protected.
